title_sq: Ne Qender, Shitet Apartament 2+1 Me Lokacion Perfekt !
description_sq: Ne Qender Perballe Hotel Plaza ,Shitet Apartament 2+1 Me Lokacion Perfekt. Apartamenti eshte i investuar duke filluar nga instalimet hidraulike dhe elektrike, sistem kondicionimi tavanor Mitsubishi, ndricim led, dritare dopioxham termike, grila elektrike , mobilim cilesor, elektroshtepiake te markave me te njohura etj. Orientimi i aparamentit eshte Jug-Perendim cka i mundeson ndricim natyral dhe diell gjate gjithe dites. Apartamenti eshte i pershtashem si per banim dhe per investim pasi kerkesa per qira ditore Bookong, Air Bnb eshte shume e larte ne zone. Apartamenti disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
title_en: In the center, 2+1 apartment for sale with a perfect location!
description_en: In the center opposite Hotel Plaza, 2+1 apartment for sale with perfect location. The apartment has a net area of ​​60.2 m2 and is located on the 4th floor of an existing 5-story building, newly insulated with a capot system. The apartment is organized in a living room with a kitchenette, a matrimonial room, a children's room and a bathroom with a window. The apartment is invested starting from the plumbing and electrical installations, Mitsubishi ceiling air conditioning system, LED lighting, thermal double-glazed windows, electric shutters, quality furniture, household appliances of the most popular brands, etc. The orientation of the appliance is South-West, which allows natural light and sun throughout the day. The apartment is suitable for living and investment as the demand for daily rent Bookong, Air Bnb is very high in the area. The apartment has regular mortgage documentation.
